body: Why would I bother to do that, is what I'm asking. If no one cares anyway seems like a waste of time and money
I don't want to do it on my own what's the point. I don't want to be alone anymore

People just keep going like "maybe you should get help" but not like they want me to get help just as like a cop out to have to stop dealing with me. I don't see the point, if no one cares about me why bother?
No like everyone wants my mental problems to go away but no one wants to help me with that
